reasoning_content: I'll add a safe.directory for the dev user to avoid permission issues, then check the git history to understand how openculturas_openstreetmap gets enabled without being in the install list.

action.command:
cd /workspace
git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace
runuser -u dev -- git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace 2>/dev/null
echo "=== git log (last 8) ==="
git log --oneline -8
echo ""
echo "=== When was openculturas_openstreetmap added to git? ==="
git log --oneline --follow -- profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml 2>&1 | tail -3
echo ""
echo "=== Does core.extension.yml in sync list openstreetmap in profile? ==="
grep -n "profile:" -A5 config/sync/core.extension.yml | head
grep -n "geocoder" config/sync/core.extension.yml
